destinations.name: Ooty
destinations.description: The Queen of Hill Stations, known for its sprawling tea gardens and colonial charm.
destinations.fullDescription: Nestled in the Nilgiri Hills, Ooty is one of the most popular hill stations in South India. It is famous for its tea plantations, pleasant climate, and the historic Nilgiri Mountain Railway.

destinations.name: Kodaikanal
destinations.description: Princess of Hill Stations with its famous star-shaped lake.
destinations.fullDescription: Located in the Palani Hills, Kodaikanal is a peaceful retreat known for its misty mountains, lush forests, and the beautiful star-shaped Kodai Lake.

destinations.name: Pondy
destinations.description: The French Riviera of the East with cobbled streets and colonial villas.
destinations.fullDescription: Pondicherry (Puducherry) is a charming coastal town that blends French colonial heritage with spiritual calm, famous for its colorful streets and serene beaches.

destinations.name: Yercaud
destinations.description: Jewel of the South, nestled in the Shevaroy Hills.
destinations.fullDescription: Yercaud is a quiet hill station in the Eastern Ghats, renowned for its orange groves, spice plantations, and the tranquil Emerald Lake.

destinations.name: Valparai
destinations.description: A pollution-free paradise with vast tea estates and dense forests.
destinations.fullDescription: Valparai is a hidden gem in the Anaimalai Hills, offering pristine nature, rich wildlife, and some of the best tea and coffee estates in South India.

destinations.name: Courtallam
destinations.description: The Spa of South India, famous for its medicinal waterfalls.
destinations.fullDescription: Courtallam is famous for its numerous waterfalls that flow over forest herbs, believed to have healing properties.

destinations.name: Kanyakumari
destinations.description: The southernmost tip of India, where three oceans meet.
destinations.fullDescription: Kanyakumari is a major pilgrimage and spiritual site where you can witness the confluence of the Arabian Sea, Bay of Bengal, and Indian Ocean.

destinations.name: Wayanad
destinations.description: A green paradise with spice plantations, waterfalls, and ancient caves.
destinations.fullDescription: Wayanad offers a unique blend of adventure and relaxation with its high mountains, dense forests, and rich spice plantations.

destinations.name: Munnar
destinations.description: The emerald tea capital of South India.
destinations.fullDescription: Munnar is one of the most romantic destinations in India, famous for its rolling hills covered in endless carpets of tea leaves.

destinations.name: Alappuzha
destinations.description: Venice of the East, famous for its backwater houseboats.
destinations.fullDescription: Alappuzha (Alleppey) is the gateway to Kerala's world-famous backwaters, where luxury houseboats cruise through tranquil canals and lagoons.

destinations.name: Kochi
destinations.description: The Queen of the Arabian Sea, a blend of heritage and culture.
destinations.fullDescription: Kochi is a vibrant port city with a mix of Portuguese, Dutch, British, and local heritage, famous for its historic Fort Kochi area.

destinations.name: Vagamon
destinations.description: Scotland of Asia with pine forests and green meadows.
destinations.fullDescription: Vagamon is an offbeat hill station in Kerala, known for its misty hills, pine forests, and breathtaking meadows.

destinations.name: Varkala
destinations.description: A coastal cliff town with spiritual vibes and pristine beaches.
destinations.fullDescription: Varkala is famous for its unique cliffs adjacent to the Arabian Sea and its spiritual significance as home to the Janardanaswamy Temple.

destinations.name: Coorg
destinations.description: The Scotland of India, famous for coffee and misty hills.
destinations.fullDescription: Coorg (Kodagu) is a lush hill station in Karnataka, famous for its coffee estates, Kodava culture, and misty mountain landscapes.

destinations.name: Chikkamagaluru
destinations.description: The coffee land of Karnataka with scenic trekking trails.
destinations.fullDescription: Chikkamagaluru is the birthplace of coffee in India, offering beautiful hills and challenging trekking trails like Mullayanagiri peaks.

destinations.name: Dandeli
destinations.description: The adventure hub for river rafting and wildlife.
destinations.fullDescription: Dandeli is a premier adventure destination in Karnataka, famous for white-water rafting on the Kali River and its diverse wildlife.

destinations.name: Gokarna
destinations.description: A spiritual temple town with pristine secluded beaches.
destinations.fullDescription: Gokarna offers a mix of spiritual heritage and laid-back beach life, famous for its unique Om-shaped beach.

destinations.name: Mysuru
destinations.description: The City of Palaces, rich in royal heritage and grand architecture.
destinations.fullDescription: Mysuru is the cultural capital of Karnataka, famous for its magnificent Mysore Palace and vibrant Dasara celebrations.

destinations.name: Hampi
destinations.description: A UNESCO World Heritage site with ancient ruins and temples.
destinations.fullDescription: Hampi is an architectural marvel featuring the ruins of the Vijayanagara Empire amidst a unique boulder-strewn landscape.

destinations.name: Goa
destinations.description: Sun, sand, and serenity on the shores of the Arabian Sea.
destinations.fullDescription: Goa is a kaleidoscope of cultures and vibrant beach life, offering a perfect mix of colonial history and tropical relaxation.

destinations.name: Manali
destinations.description: The adventure capital of Himachal Pradesh.
destinations.fullDescription: Manali is a beautiful valley in the Himalayas, offering snow-capped mountains and thrilling adventure activities year-round.

destinations.name: Ladakh
destinations.description: The Land of High Passes with stunning high-altitude landscapes.
destinations.fullDescription: Ladakh is a paradise for adventurers, known for its high-altitude deserts, blue lakes, and ancient Buddhist monasteries.

destinations.name: Delhi
destinations.description: The vibrant capital city of India.
destinations.fullDescription: Delhi is a historic city that serves as the heart of India, featuring magnificent monuments and a rich culinary culture.

destinations.name: Mumbai
destinations.description: The city of dreams and financial capital of India.
destinations.fullDescription: Mumbai is a bustling metropolis on the west coast of India, known for its colonial library, Bollywood fame, and vibrant energy.

destinations.name: Kashmir
destinations.description: Heaven on Earth with its serene lakes and snowy hills.
destinations.fullDescription: Kashmir is world-renowned for its breathtaking natural beauty, featuring snowy peaks, lush valleys, and serene shikara rides on Dal Lake.

destinations.name: Madurai
destinations.description: Athens of the East, home to Meenakshi Amman Temple.
destinations.fullDescription: One of the oldest continuously inhabited cities in the world, focused around its majestic temple and rich Dravidian history.

destinations.name: Rameswaram
destinations.description: One of the Char Dham pilgrimage sites on a beautiful island.
destinations.fullDescription: Rameswaram is a holy city believed to be where Lord Rama built a bridge to Lanka, connected by the engineering marvel of Pamban Bridge.

destinations.name: Velankanni
destinations.description: The Lourdes of the East, a major Catholic center.
destinations.fullDescription: Famous for the Basilica of Our Lady of Good Health, attracting millions of pilgrims from all faiths annually.

destinations.name: Tiruchendur
destinations.description: Abode of Lord Murugan located on the seashore.
destinations.fullDescription: A unique coastal temple dedicated to Lord Murugan, offering a serene and powerful spiritual experience by the sea.
